name: commerceagent-desktop
description: Electron shell for CommerceAgent (bundles the Node sidecar backend + web UI).

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run fetch-node:all && npm run stage:arm64 && npm run stage:x64 && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run fetch-node:all && npm run stage:win && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --dir
scripts.fetch-node:all: node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64
